page.content:
Author of the Foundation novels.

How Isaac Asimov connects

  • Topic: Foundation — Isaac Asimov created the Foundation series.
  • Work: Foundation (book) — Asimov wrote the stories collected as Foundation.
  • Work: Foundation and Empire — Asimov wrote Foundation and Empire.
  • Work: Second Foundation — Asimov wrote Second Foundation.

What is Isaac Asimov?

Isaac Asimov wrote the Foundation stories from the 1940s onward, inventing psychohistory, Terminus, the Seldon Plan, and the later ties to his robot novels.

Key threads lead to Foundation, Foundation (book), Foundation and Empire and Second Foundation.
